exchanges.transcript: Good morning, Ms. Chen. I found reservation OS-24817: three nights, from 21 to 24 June.
exchanges.translation: 早上好，陈女士。我找到了预订 OS-24817：6月21日至24日，共三晚。

exchanges.transcript: 谢谢。请确认包含早餐，退房时间是上午十一点。
exchanges.translation: Thank you. Please confirm breakfast is included and checkout is at 11:00 a.m.

exchanges.transcript: Welcome back. We can continue from your previous request.
exchanges.translation: 歡迎返嚟。我哋可以由你之前嘅請求繼續。

exchanges.transcript: 好呀，我只需要確認返探訪時間。
exchanges.translation: Perfect. I only need to confirm the appointment time.
